name: cloudru-s3-mcp-ai-cli
description: Cloud.ru Evolution S3 backups for Cursor: find and restore a file from a backup, see where the bucket's space goes. Read-only: the bundled server cannot write, delete or move objects.

CLOUDRU_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.title: Cloud.ru Evolution S3 access key ID
CLOUDRU_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: S3 access key ID; a key scoped to the backup buckets is enough.

CLOUDRU_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.title: Cloud.ru Evolution S3 secret access key
CLOUDRU_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: S3 secret access key for that key ID.

CLOUDRU_S3_POOL.title: Cloud.ru Evolution S3 pool
CLOUDRU_S3_POOL.description: Pool (region) of the bucket; it sets both the endpoint and the signing region.
